  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an upward reserve sizing study for CISO with a 120-minute horizon and shortfall cost 20.0. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"

  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "The request specifies a supported region (CISO), supported horizon (120 minutes), supported shortfall cost (20.0), and the standard rolling design (train_days=730, cal_days=30, test_days=30, rolling_step_days=30). The operator explicitly requests no MW estimation, which aligns with the policy that numerical outputs are computed only by the verified workflow.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "CISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 120,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 20.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_cost_and_rolling_design",
    "construct_admissible_variables_and_forbidden_variables",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "produce_numerical_outputs_only_from_verified_workflow",
    "record_audit_log_and_require_human_approval"
  ]
}
